subject.title: fix(line): prevent silent webhook loss after acknowledgment

question: Should this protected maintainer PR require a real LINE webhook and restart proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override that gate based on the source-blind scenario run and manual merged-tree review?
rationale: The patch and focused tests are strong, but the contributor-associated PR has no inspectable transport evidence and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Require live LINE proof
options.body: Capture a redacted real webhook, acknowledgment, restart, and redelivery run before approving the message-delivery lifecycle change.

options.title: Record a proof override
options.body: A qualified maintainer may explicitly accept the source-blind scenarios and manual review as sufficient for this change’s transport risk.

recommendation.title: Require live LINE proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted real webhook, acknowledgment, restart, and redelivery run before approving the message-delivery lifecycle change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner of the shared durable-ingress lifecycle and cross-channel adoption direction.
